name: dark-listener-wallet-showcase
changes: Returns customer, listener and admin portals to a refined dark theme without changing the working Razorpay Standard Checkout popup flow
Redesigns the listener signed-in home with a visual hero, clearer availability controls, compact work stats and an auto-hiding header that returns at the top or on upward scroll
Simplifies the listener wallet to balance, per-minute rate, saved UPI destination and withdrawal amount/request controls; payout details edit only on demand and are reachable from Settings
Adds an admin Public images manager for up to 12 compressed portrait previews stored in platform settings and shuffled daily on customer/listener public screens
Reshapes customer talk-time plans into taller narrow cards with 2 columns on phones and up to 5 columns on desktop
Bumps PWA caches and asset versions to 8.9.4
